108	def build_parameter_values(pybamm, parameter_set: str):
109	    module = import_module(f"pybamm.input.parameters.lithium_ion.{parameter_set}")
110	    params = pybamm.ParameterValues(module.get_parameter_values())
111	    if parameter_set == "Xu2019":
112	        params.update(PUBLIC_PARAMETER_OVERRIDES, check_already_exists=False)
113	    return params

116	def boundary_condition_for_symbol(model, symbol_type, *fragments: str):
117	    for key, bc_map in model.boundary_conditions.items():
118	        if isinstance(key, symbol_type) and all(
119	            fragment in str(key) for fragment in fragments
120	        ):
121	            return bc_map
122	    raise AssertionError(
123	        f"missing boundary conditions for {symbol_type.__name__} matching {fragments!r}"
124	    )
125	
126	
127	def boundary_signature(pybamm, model):
128	    surface_potential = boundary_condition_for_symbol(
129	        model,
130	        pybamm.Concatenation,
131	        "Lithium metal interface surface potential difference [V]",
132	        "Positive electrode surface potential difference [V]",
133	    )
134	    electrolyte_concentration = boundary_condition_for_symbol(
135	        model,
136	        pybamm.Concatenation,
137	        "Separator porosity times concentration [mol.m-3]",
138	        "Positive electrode porosity times concentration [mol.m-3]",
139	    )
140	    return {
141	        "boundary_condition_count": len(model.boundary_conditions),
142	        "surface_potential_boundary": {
143	            "left": surface_potential["left"][1],
144	            "right": surface_potential["right"][1],
145	        },
146	        "electrolyte_concentration_boundary": {
147	            "left": electrolyte_concentration["left"][1],
148	            "right": electrolyte_concentration["right"][1],
149	        },
150	    }
151

153	def run_scenario(pybamm, scenario: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, object]:
154	    params = build_parameter_values(pybamm, scenario["parameter_set"])
155	    model_cls = getattr(pybamm.lithium_ion, scenario["model"])
156	    model = model_cls(dict(scenario["options"]))
157	    sim = pybamm.Simulation(model, parameter_values=params, C_rate=scenario["c_rate"])
158	    sim.build()
159	    built_model = sim._model
160	    solution = sim.solve(scenario["t_eval"])
161	    times = np.linspace(scenario["t_eval"][0], scenario["t_eval"][-1], 5)
162	    voltage = np.asarray(solution["Voltage [V]"](times), dtype=float)
163	    temperature = np.asarray(
164	        solution["Volume-averaged cell temperature [K]"](times), dtype=float
165	    )
166	    ohmic_heating = np.asarray(
167	        solution["Volume-averaged Ohmic heating [W.m-3]"](times), dtype=float
168	    )
169	    result = {
170	        "status": "ok",
171	        "model": scenario["model"],
172	        "t_eval": list(scenario["t_eval"]),
173	        "c_rate": scenario["c_rate"],
174	        "initial_voltage": float(voltage[0]),
175	        "final_voltage": float(voltage[-1]),
176	        "voltage_drop": float(voltage[0] - voltage[-1]),
177	        "initial_temperature": float(temperature[0]),
178	        "final_temperature": float(temperature[-1]),
179	        "max_temperature": float(np.max(temperature)),
180	        "final_ohmic_heating": float(ohmic_heating[-1]),
181	        "max_ohmic_heating": float(np.max(ohmic_heating)),
182	        "finite": bool(
183	            np.all(np.isfinite(voltage))
184	            and np.all(np.isfinite(temperature))
185	            and np.all(np.isfinite(ohmic_heating))
186	        ),
187	        "points": int(voltage.size),
188	    }
189	    if (
190	        scenario["options"].get("working electrode") == "positive"
191	        and scenario["options"].get("surface form") == "differential"
192	        and scenario["options"].get("thermal") == "lumped"
193	    ):
194	        result["boundary_signature"] = boundary_signature(pybamm, built_model)
195	    return result

61	
62	        # Potentials at the anode/separator interface
63	        phi_s = phi_s_cc - delta_phi_s
64	        phi_e = phi_s - delta_phi
65	
66	        variables.update(
67	            self._get_li_metal_interface_variables(delta_phi_s, phi_s, phi_e)
68	        )
69	        return variables
70	
71	    def set_initial_conditions(self, variables):
72	        delta_phi = variables[
73	            "Lithium metal interface surface potential difference [V]"
74	        ]
75	        delta_phi_init = self.domain_param.prim.U_init
76	
77	        self.initial_conditions = {delta_phi: delta_phi_init}
78	
79	    def set_rhs(self, variables):
80	        Domain = self.domain.capitalize()
81	        if self.options["surface form"] == "differential":
82	            j_pl = variables["Lithium metal plating current density [A.m-2]"]
83	            j_sei = variables[
84	                f"{Domain} electrode SEI interfacial current density [A.m-2]"
85	            ]
86	            sum_j = j_pl + j_sei
87	
88	            i_cc = variables["Current collector current density [A.m-2]"]
89	            delta_phi = variables[
90	                "Lithium metal interface surface potential difference [V]"
91	            ]
92	            # temperature at the interface of the negative electrode with the separator
93	            T = pybamm.boundary_value(
94	                variables["Negative electrode temperature [K]"], "right"
95	            )
96	
97	            C_dl = self.domain_param.C_dl(T)
98	
99	            self.rhs[delta_phi] = 1 / C_dl * (i_cc - sum_j)
100	
101	    def set_algebraic(self, variables):
102	        Domain = self.domain.capitalize()
103	        if self.options["surface form"] != "differential":  # also catches "false"
104	            j_pl = variables["Lithium metal plating current density [A.m-2]"]
105	            j_sei = variables[
106	                f"{Domain} electrode SEI interfacial current density [A.m-2]"
107	            ]
108	            sum_j = j_pl + j_sei
109	
110	            i_cc = variables["Current collector current density [A.m-2]"]
111	            delta_phi = variables[
112	                "Lithium metal interface surface potential difference [V]"
113	            ]
114	
115	            self.algebraic[delta_phi] = (i_cc - sum_j) / self.param.I_typ

117	
118	class LithiumMetalExplicit(LithiumMetalBaseModel):
119	    """Explicit model for potential drop across a lithium metal electrode.
120	
121	    Parameters
122	    ----------
123	    param : parameter class
124	        The parameters to use for this submodel
125	    options : dict, optional
126	        A dictionary of options to be passed to the model.
127	    """
128	
129	    def get_coupled_variables(self, variables):
130	        Domain = self.domain.capitalize()
131	        domain_param = self.domain_param
132	
133	        i_boundary_cc = variables["Current collector current density [A.m-2]"]
134	        T = variables[f"{Domain} current collector temperature [K]"]
135	        L = domain_param.L
136	        delta_phi_s = i_boundary_cc * L / domain_param.sigma(None, T)
137	
138	        phi_s_cc = variables[f"{Domain} current collector potential [V]"]
139	        delta_phi = variables[
140	            "Lithium metal interface surface potential difference [V]"
141	        ]
142	
143	        phi_s = phi_s_cc - delta_phi_s
144	        phi_e = phi_s - delta_phi
145	
146	        variables.update(
147	            self._get_li_metal_interface_variables(delta_phi_s, phi_s, phi_e)
148	        )
149	        return variables

1	#
2	# Composite electrolyte potential employing integrated Stefan-Maxwell
3	#
4	import pybamm
5	
6	from .base_electrolyte_conductivity import BaseElectrolyteConductivity
7	
8	
9	class Integrated(BaseElectrolyteConductivity):
10	    """
11	    Integrated model for conservation of charge in the electrolyte derived from
12	    integrating the Stefan-Maxwell constitutive equations, from
13	    :footcite:t:`BrosaPlanella2021`.
14	
15	    Parameters
16	    ----------
17	    param : parameter class
18	        The parameters to use for this submodel
19	    domain : str, optional
20	        The domain in which the model holds
21	    options : dict, optional
22	        A dictionary of options to be passed to the model.
23	
24	    """
25	
26	    def __init__(self, param, domain=None, options=None):
27	        super().__init__(param, domain, options=options)
28	        pybamm.citations.register("BrosaPlanella2021")
29	
30	    def _higher_order_macinnes_function(self, x):
31	        tol = pybamm.settings.tolerances["macinnes__c_e"]
32	        x = pybamm.maximum(x, tol)
33	        return pybamm.log(x)
34	
35	    def get_coupled_variables(self, variables):
36	        c_e_av = variables["X-averaged electrolyte concentration [mol.m-3]"]
37	
38	        i_boundary_cc = variables["Current collector current density [A.m-2]"]
39	        c_e_n = variables["Negative electrolyte concentration [mol.m-3]"]
40	        c_e_s = variables["Separator electrolyte concentration [mol.m-3]"]
41	        c_e_p = variables["Positive electrolyte concentration [mol.m-3]"]
42	        c_e_n0 = pybamm.boundary_value(c_e_n, "left")
43	
44	        delta_phi_n_av = variables[
45	            "X-averaged negative electrode surface potential difference [V]"
46	        ]
47	        phi_s_n_av = variables["X-averaged negative electrode potential [V]"]
48	
49	        tor_n = variables["Negative electrolyte transport efficiency"]
50	        tor_s = variables["Separator electrolyte transport efficiency"]
51	        tor_p = variables["Positive electrolyte transport efficiency"]
52	
53	        T_av = variables["X-averaged cell temperature [K]"]
54	        T_av_n = pybamm.PrimaryBroadcast(T_av, "negative electrode")
55	        T_av_s = pybamm.PrimaryBroadcast(T_av, "separator")
56	        T_av_p = pybamm.PrimaryBroadcast(T_av, "positive electrode")
57	
58	        RT_F_av = self.param.R * T_av / self.param.F
59	        RT_F_av_n = self.param.R * T_av_n / self.param.F
60	        RT_F_av_s = self.param.R * T_av_s / self.param.F
61	        RT_F_av_p = self.param.R * T_av_p / self.param.F
62	
63	        L_n = self.param.n.L
64	        L_p = self.param.p.L
65	        L_x = self.param.L_x
66	        x_n = pybamm.standard_spatial_vars.x_n
67	        x_s = pybamm.standard_spatial_vars.x_s
68	        x_p = pybamm.standard_spatial_vars.x_p
69	        x_n_edge = pybamm.standard_spatial_vars.x_n_edge
70	        x_p_edge = pybamm.standard_spatial_vars.x_p_edge
71	
72	        chi_av = self.param.chi(c_e_av, T_av)
73	        chi_av_n = pybamm.PrimaryBroadcast(chi_av, "negative electrode")
74	        chi_av_s = pybamm.PrimaryBroadcast(chi_av, "separator")
75	        chi_av_p = pybamm.PrimaryBroadcast(chi_av, "positive electrode")
76	
77	        # electrolyte current
78	        i_e_n = i_boundary_cc * x_n / L_n
79	        i_e_s = pybamm.PrimaryBroadcast(i_boundary_cc, "separator")
80	        i_e_p = i_boundary_cc * (L_x - x_p) / L_p
81	        i_e = pybamm.concatenation(i_e_n, i_e_s, i_e_p)
82	
83	        i_e_n_edge = i_boundary_cc * x_n_edge / L_n
84	        i_e_s_edge = pybamm.PrimaryBroadcastToEdges(i_boundary_cc, "separator")
85	        i_e_p_edge = i_boundary_cc * (L_x - x_p_edge) / L_p
86	
87	        # electrolyte potential
88	        indef_integral_n = pybamm.IndefiniteIntegral(
89	            i_e_n_edge / (self.param.kappa_e(c_e_n, T_av_n) * tor_n), x_n
90	        )
91	        indef_integral_s = pybamm.IndefiniteIntegral(
92	            i_e_s_edge / (self.param.kappa_e(c_e_s, T_av_s) * tor_s), x_s
93	        )
94	        indef_integral_p = pybamm.IndefiniteIntegral(
95	            i_e_p_edge / (self.param.kappa_e(c_e_p, T_av_p) * tor_p), x_p
96	        )
97	
98	        integral_n = indef_integral_n
99	        integral_s = indef_integral_s + pybamm.boundary_value(integral_n, "right")
100	        integral_p = indef_integral_p + pybamm.boundary_value(integral_s, "right")
101	
102	        phi_e_const = (
103	            -delta_phi_n_av
104	            + phi_s_n_av
105	            - (
106	                chi_av
107	                * RT_F_av
108	                * pybamm.x_average(self._higher_order_macinnes_function(c_e_n / c_e_n0))
109	            )
110	            + pybamm.x_average(integral_n)
111	        )
112	
113	        phi_e_n = (
114	            phi_e_const
115	            + (
116	                chi_av_n
117	                * RT_F_av_n
118	                * self._higher_order_macinnes_function(c_e_n / c_e_n0)
119	            )
120	            - integral_n
121	        )
122	
123	        phi_e_s = (
124	            phi_e_const
125	            + (
126	                chi_av_s
127	                * RT_F_av_s
128	                * self._higher_order_macinnes_function(c_e_s / c_e_n0)
129	            )
130	            - integral_s
131	        )
132	
133	        phi_e_p = (
134	            phi_e_const
135	            + (
136	                chi_av_p
137	                * RT_F_av_p
138	                * self._higher_order_macinnes_function(c_e_p / c_e_n0)
139	            )
140	            - integral_p
141	        )
142	
143	        # concentration overpotential
144	        eta_c_av = (
145	            chi_av
146	            * RT_F_av
147	            * (
148	                pybamm.x_average(self._higher_order_macinnes_function(c_e_p / c_e_av))
149	                - pybamm.x_average(self._higher_order_macinnes_function(c_e_n / c_e_av))
150	            )
151	        )
152	
153	        # average electrolyte ohmic losses
154	        delta_phi_e_av = -(pybamm.x_average(integral_p) - pybamm.x_average(integral_n))
155	
156	        phi_e_dict = {
157	            "negative electrode": phi_e_n,
158	            "separator": phi_e_s,
159	            "positive electrode": phi_e_p,
160	        }
161	        variables.update(self._get_standard_potential_variables(phi_e_dict))
162	        variables.update(self._get_standard_current_variables(i_e))
163	        variables.update(self._get_split_overpotential(eta_c_av, delta_phi_e_av))
164	
165	        return variables

1	#
2	# Doyle-Fuller-Newman (DFN) Model
3	#
4	import pybamm
5	
6	from .base_lithium_ion_model import BaseModel
7	
8	
9	class DFN(BaseModel):
10	    """
11	    Doyle-Fuller-Newman (DFN) model of a lithium-ion battery, from
12	    :footcite:t:`Marquis2019`. See :class:`pybamm.lithium_ion.BaseModel` for more
13	    details.
14	
15	    Examples
16	    --------
17	    >>> model = pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN()
18	    >>> model.name
19	    'Doyle-Fuller-Newman model'
20	
21	    """
22	
23	    def __init__(self, options=None, name="Doyle-Fuller-Newman model", build=True):
24	        # For degradation models we use the full form since this is a full-order model
25	        self.x_average = False
26	        super().__init__(options, name)
27	
28	        self.set_submodels(build)
29	
30	        pybamm.citations.register("Doyle1993")
31	
32	    def set_intercalation_kinetics_submodel(self):
33	        for domain in ["negative", "positive"]:
34	            electrode_type = self.options.electrode_types[domain]
35	            if electrode_type == "porous":
36	                intercalation_kinetics = self.get_intercalation_kinetics(domain)
37	                phases = self.options.phases[domain]
38	                for phase in phases:
39	                    submod = intercalation_kinetics(
40	                        self.param, domain, "lithium-ion main", self.options, phase
41	                    )
42	                    self.submodels[f"{domain} {phase} interface"] = submod
43	
44	                if len(phases) > 1:
45	                    self.submodels[f"total {domain} interface"] = (
46	                        pybamm.kinetics.TotalMainKinetics(
47	                            self.param, domain, "lithium-ion main", self.options
48	                        )
49	                    )
50	
51	    def set_particle_submodel(self):
52	        for domain in ["negative", "positive"]:
53	            if self.options.electrode_types[domain] == "planar":
54	                continue
55	            particle = getattr(self.options, domain)["particle"]
56	            for phase in self.options.phases[domain]:
57	                if particle == "Fickian diffusion":
58	                    submod = pybamm.particle.FickianDiffusion(
59	                        self.param, domain, self.options, phase=phase, x_average=False
60	                    )
61	                elif particle in [
62	                    "uniform profile",
63	                    "quadratic profile",
64	                    "quartic profile",
65	                ]:
66	                    submod = pybamm.particle.PolynomialProfile(
67	                        self.param, domain, self.options, phase=phase
68	                    )
69	                elif particle == "MSMR":
70	                    submod = pybamm.particle.MSMRDiffusion(
71	                        self.param, domain, self.options, phase=phase, x_average=False
72	                    )
73	                    # also set the submodel for calculating stoichiometry from
74	                    # potential
75	                    self.submodels[f"{domain} {phase} stoichiometry"] = (
76	                        pybamm.particle.MSMRStoichiometryVariables(
77	                            self.param,
78	                            domain,
79	                            self.options,
80	                            phase=phase,
81	                            x_average=False,
82	                        )
83	                    )
84	                self.submodels[f"{domain} {phase} particle"] = submod
85	                self.submodels[f"{domain} {phase} total particle concentration"] = (
86	                    pybamm.particle.TotalConcentration(
87	                        self.param, domain, self.options, phase
88	                    )
89	                )
90	
91	    def set_solid_submodel(self):
92	        for domain in ["negative", "positive"]:
93	            if self.options.electrode_types[domain] == "planar":
94	                continue
95	            if self.options["surface form"] == "false":
96	                submodel = pybamm.electrode.ohm.Full
97	            else:
98	                submodel = pybamm.electrode.ohm.SurfaceForm
99	            self.submodels[f"{domain} electrode potential"] = submodel(
100	                self.param, domain, self.options
101	            )
102	
103	    def set_electrolyte_concentration_submodel(self):
104	        self.submodels["electrolyte diffusion"] = pybamm.electrolyte_diffusion.Full(
105	            self.param, self.options
106	        )
107	
108	    def set_electrolyte_potential_submodel(self):
109	        surf_form = pybamm.electrolyte_conductivity.surface_potential_form
110	
111	        if self.options["electrolyte conductivity"] not in ["default", "full"]:
112	            raise pybamm.OptionError(
113	                "electrolyte conductivity '{}' not suitable for DFN".format(
114	                    self.options["electrolyte conductivity"]
115	                )
116	            )
117	
118	        if self.options["surface form"] == "false":
119	            self.submodels["electrolyte conductivity"] = (
120	                pybamm.electrolyte_conductivity.Full(self.param, self.options)
121	            )
122	
123	        if self.options["surface form"] == "false":
124	            surf_model = surf_form.Explicit
125	        elif self.options["surface form"] == "differential":
126	            surf_model = surf_form.FullDifferential
127	        elif self.options["surface form"] == "algebraic":
128	            surf_model = surf_form.FullAlgebraic
129	
130	        for domain in ["negative", "separator", "positive"]:
131	            if self.options.electrode_types.get(domain) == "planar":
132	                continue
133	            self.submodels[f"{domain} surface potential difference"] = surf_model(
134	                self.param, domain, self.options
135	            )
136	
137	    def set_summary_variables(self):
138	        self.set_default_summary_variables()

1	#
2	# Class for full surface form electrolyte conductivity employing stefan-maxwell
3	#
4	import pybamm
5	from pybamm.models.submodels.electrolyte_conductivity.base_electrolyte_conductivity import (
6	    BaseElectrolyteConductivity,
7	)
8	
9	
10	class BaseModel(BaseElectrolyteConductivity):
11	    """Base class for conservation of charge in the electrolyte employing the
12	    Stefan-Maxwell constitutive equations employing the surface potential difference
13	    formulation.
14	
15	    Parameters
16	    ----------
17	    param : parameter class
18	        The parameters to use for this submodel
19	    domain : str
20	        The domain in which the model holds
21	    options : dict, optional
22	        A dictionary of options to be passed to the model.
23	    """
24	
25	    def __init__(self, param, domain, options=None):
26	        super().__init__(param, domain, options)
27	
28	    def get_fundamental_variables(self):
29	        if self.domain == "separator":
30	            return {}
31	
32	        domain, Domain = self.domain_Domain
33	        delta_phi = pybamm.Variable(
34	            f"{Domain} electrode surface potential difference [V]",
35	            domain=f"{domain} electrode",
36	            auxiliary_domains={"secondary": "current collector"},
37	            reference=self.domain_param.prim.U_init,
38	        )
39	        variables = self._get_standard_average_surface_potential_difference_variables(
40	            pybamm.x_average(delta_phi)
41	        )
42	        variables.update(
43	            self._get_standard_surface_potential_difference_variables(delta_phi)
44	        )
45	
46	        return variables
47	
48	    def get_coupled_variables(self, variables):
49	        Domain = self.domain.capitalize()
50	
51	        if self.domain in ["negative", "positive"]:
52	            conductivity, sigma_eff = self._get_conductivities(variables)
53	            i_boundary_cc = variables["Current collector current density [A.m-2]"]
54	            c_e = variables[f"{Domain} electrolyte concentration [mol.m-3]"]
55	            delta_phi = variables[
56	                f"{Domain} electrode surface potential difference [V]"
57	            ]
58	            T = variables[f"{Domain} electrode temperature [K]"]
59	
60	            i_e = conductivity * (
61	                self.param.chiRT_over_Fc(c_e, T) * pybamm.grad(c_e)
62	                + pybamm.grad(delta_phi)
63	                + i_boundary_cc / sigma_eff
64	            )
65	            variables[f"{Domain} electrolyte current density [A.m-2]"] = i_e
66	
67	            phi_s = variables[f"{Domain} electrode potential [V]"]
68	            phi_e = phi_s - delta_phi
69	
70	        elif self.domain == "separator":
71	            x_s = pybamm.standard_spatial_vars.x_s
72	
73	            i_boundary_cc = variables["Current collector current density [A.m-2]"]
74	            c_e_s = variables["Separator electrolyte concentration [mol.m-3]"]
75	            if self.options.electrode_types["negative"] == "planar":
76	                phi_e_n_s = variables[
77	                    "Lithium metal interface electrolyte potential [V]"
78	                ]
79	            else:
80	                phi_e_n = variables["Negative electrolyte potential [V]"]
81	                phi_e_n_s = pybamm.boundary_value(phi_e_n, "right")
82	            tor_s = variables["Separator electrolyte transport efficiency"]
83	            T = variables["Separator temperature [K]"]
84	
85	            chiRT_over_Fc_e_s = self.param.chiRT_over_Fc(c_e_s, T)
86	            kappa_s_eff = self.param.kappa_e(c_e_s, T) * tor_s
87	
88	            phi_e = phi_e_n_s + pybamm.IndefiniteIntegral(
89	                chiRT_over_Fc_e_s * pybamm.grad(c_e_s) - i_boundary_cc / kappa_s_eff,
90	                x_s,
91	            )
92	
93	            i_e = pybamm.PrimaryBroadcastToEdges(i_boundary_cc, "separator")
94	            variables[f"{Domain} electrolyte current density [A.m-2]"] = i_e
95	
96	            self.boundary_conditions[c_e_s] = {
97	                "left": (pybamm.boundary_gradient(c_e_s, "left"), "Neumann"),
98	                "right": (pybamm.boundary_gradient(c_e_s, "right"), "Neumann"),
99	            }
100	
101	        variables[f"{Domain} electrolyte potential [V]"] = phi_e
102	
103	        if self.domain == "positive":
104	            phi_e_dict = {}
105	            i_e_dict = {}
106	            for domain in self.options.whole_cell_domains:
107	                Domain = domain.capitalize().split()[0]
108	                phi_e_dict[domain] = variables[f"{Domain} electrolyte potential [V]"]
109	                i_e_dict[domain] = variables[
110	                    f"{Domain} electrolyte current density [A.m-2]"
111	                ]
112	
113	            variables.update(self._get_standard_potential_variables(phi_e_dict))
114	
115	            i_e = pybamm.concatenation(*i_e_dict.values())
116	            variables.update(self._get_standard_current_variables(i_e))
117	            variables.update(self._get_electrolyte_overpotentials(variables))
118	
119	        if self.domain == "negative":
120	            grad_c_e = pybamm.boundary_gradient(c_e, "right")
121	            grad_left = -i_boundary_cc * pybamm.boundary_value(1 / sigma_eff, "left")
122	            grad_right = (
123	                (i_boundary_cc / pybamm.boundary_value(conductivity, "right"))
124	                - pybamm.boundary_value(self.param.chiRT_over_Fc(c_e, T), "right")
125	                * grad_c_e
126	                - i_boundary_cc * pybamm.boundary_value(1 / sigma_eff, "right")
127	            )
128	
129	        elif self.domain == "positive":
130	            grad_c_e = pybamm.boundary_gradient(c_e, "left")
131	            grad_left = (
132	                (i_boundary_cc / pybamm.boundary_value(conductivity, "left"))
133	                - pybamm.boundary_value(self.param.chiRT_over_Fc(c_e, T), "left")
134	                * grad_c_e
135	                - i_boundary_cc * pybamm.boundary_value(1 / sigma_eff, "left")
136	            )
137	            grad_right = -i_boundary_cc * pybamm.boundary_value(1 / sigma_eff, "right")
138	
139	        if self.domain in ["negative", "positive"]:
140	            variables.update(
141	                {
142	                    f"{self.domain} grad(delta_phi) left": grad_left,
143	                    f"{self.domain} grad(delta_phi) right": grad_right,
144	                    f"{self.domain} grad(c_e) internal": grad_c_e,
145	                }
146	            )
147	        return variables
148	
149	    def _get_conductivities(self, variables):
150	        Domain = self.domain.capitalize()
151	
152	        tor_e = variables[f"{Domain} electrolyte transport efficiency"]
153	        tor_s = variables[f"{Domain} electrode transport efficiency"]
154	        c_e = variables[f"{Domain} electrolyte concentration [mol.m-3]"]
155	        T = variables[f"{Domain} electrode temperature [K]"]
156	        sto = None
157	        for phase in ("", "primary "):
158	            name = f"{Domain} {phase}particle surface stoichiometry"
159	            if name in variables:
160	                sto = variables[name]
161	                break
162	        sigma = self.domain_param.sigma(sto, T)
163	
164	        kappa_eff = self.param.kappa_e(c_e, T) * tor_e
165	        sigma_eff = sigma * tor_s
166	        conductivity = kappa_eff / (1 + kappa_eff / sigma_eff)
167	
168	        return conductivity, sigma_eff
169	
170	    def set_initial_conditions(self, variables):
171	        Domain = self.domain.capitalize()
172	
173	        if self.domain == "separator":
174	            return

events.text:
The reproduction is repaired — `python reproduce.py` now exits 0 with `workflow_completed` and all four scenarios produce finite results.

## Root cause

Only `case_03` failed: a half-cell (`"working electrode": "positive"`) with `"surface form": "differential"` and `"thermal": "lumped"` died with a `ShapeError` — a `(n,k=21)` arithmetic-mean matrix applied to a 19-entry array while building the temperature equation.

Two boundary-condition registrations are missing for half-cell models whose counter electrode is a planar lithium-metal foil:

- `base_ohm.py:45` skipped setting **all** solid-electrode boundary conditions whenever the negative electrode is planar. But that `_phi_s` gradient is only well-posed with Neumann conditions at the separator interface and current collector; without them the FV gradient yields 19 internal edges instead of 21, and the edge-to-node average in `inner(i_s_p, grad(phi_s_p))` mismatches.
- `full_surface_form_conductivity.py` never registered the whole-cell **electrolyte** potential boundary condition in the planar-negative case (full cells register it from the negative-domain submodel, which half cells skip). The separator fragment therefore had no left ghost/edge condition for `grad(phi_e_s)` in the Ohmic-heating term.

## Fix (in `<patch-omitted>`)

- `.../electrode/ohm/base_ohm.py` — restrict the planar skip to `self.domain == "negative"`, so the positive electrode still gets its Neumann conditions (matches what `full_ohm.py` already does for half cells).
- `.../surface_potential_form/full_surface_form_conductivity.py` — when the negative is planar, register the whole-cell electrolyte potential BCs from the separator submodel: Dirichlet-anchored to the lithium-metal interface potential on the left, zero-flux Neumann on the right, mirroring `BaseElectrolyteConductivity.set_boundary_conditions`.

## Verification

- `case_03` builds, solves, and stays finite; the report shows `temperature_rise ≈ 6.5e-5 K` and `peak_ohmic_heating ≈ 0.4 W/m³`, consistent with Xu2019 being a 2.4 mAh coin-cell half-cell (2.4 mA at 1 C).
- Byte-identical outputs for every previously-working configuration (full-cell DFN/SPM/SPMe, isothermal half cells, algebraic/differential forms) across a parameter sweep — no regressions.
- The fix generalizes: no fixture hard-coding; it works across parameter sets, C-rates, and both differential and algebraic surface forms (algebraic half-cell lumped also repaired, differential variants at 0.2–1.5 C pass, x-lumped correctly still rejects non-pouch geometry).
